summary: First-finish smoke test of LUNAVIA. All 6 backend endpoints working, SSE briefing streams Claude Sonnet 5 tokens in Portuguese-BR and terminates with event: done. Frontend: Landing, Mission and Manifesto pages fully functional. 3D canvases (hero-canvas, mission-canvas) render. HUD (MET/telemetry/mission-ident), 9-phase timeline, mission controls (play/speed/reset/scrub), and briefing panel all wired. MET increments over time, phase-jump-p04 changes MET, ctrl-speed cycles (observed ×3,600 -> ×14,400), reset works, and briefing-transmit-btn streams SSE tokens into briefing-text progressively (0 -> 1198 chars, PT-BR flight director voice). Navigation nav-mission / nav-manifesto / nav-home all work.
passed: GET /api/ returns {service:'LUNAVIA', tagline:'THE ROAD TO THE MOON', status:'nominal'} 200
GET /api/mission/phases returns 9 phases; p01=PRELAUNCH, p04=TLI, p09=REENTRY & SPLASHDOWN
POST /api/mission/briefing {p04, concise} streams SSE data: lines from Claude Sonnet 5 in PT-BR, terminates with event: done
POST /api/mission/log persists entry and GET /api/mission/log/{session_id} returns it
Landing renders THE ROAD TO THE MOON, hero-canvas, hero-cta-mission, hero-cta-manifesto
Navbar nav-mission / nav-manifesto / nav-home route correctly
Mission page renders mission-canvas, hud-mission-ident, hud-met, hud-telemetry, briefing-panel, all ctrl-* and phase-jump-p01..p09
MET increments over time (T+004:43:59 -> T+006:38:59 during ~1.8s at ×3600)
ctrl-reset returns to T-window (observed T+000:44:00 after brief drift at high speed)
briefing-transmit-btn streams tokens progressively into briefing-text (final ~1198 chars PT-BR)
Manifesto page shows IDENTIDADE, FANTASIA CENTRAL, NORTH STAR sections
